# Marseille Control
> **Reminder**: This document is intended for use by air traffic controllers on the VATSIM network only and is exclusively for flight simulation purposes. It shall not be used for real-world air traffic control operations.
{.is-warning}

Marseille Area Control Centre provides en-route air traffic control services within the upper airspace of south-eastern France. It also manages the sectors serving the major airports located within its area of responsibility.

![ccr_lfmm_fl245-fl660.png](/doc-atc/lfmm/acc/ccr_lfmm_fl245-fl660.png =75%x){.align-center}

The Centre position may be split into two primary sectors: **East (RAE)** and **West (RAW)**.

When the Centre position is operated as a single sector, the **Bandbox** sector assumes responsibility for all sectors described above.

In addition, during events or as operationally required, individual upper sectors may be opened and provide ATS within their respective vertical limits.

## Control Positions and Limitations
> Marseille Control is an **unrestricted** position. Nevertheless, controllers are strongly encouraged to familiarize themselves with this documentation before providing the position.
> 
> When no approach positions are staffed, Marseille Control shall provide ATS to the underlying aerodromes in accordance with the top-down principle.
{.is-info}


> In addition, it does not have its own certification. However, controllers are highly recommended to obtain the relevant Tier-1 Nice Approach endorsement beforehand.
>
> In the absence of the corresponding approach position, **this endorsement becomes mandatory for controllers wishing to open any position providing top-down services at the associated aerodrome**.
{.is-warning}

```diagram

```


> “Bandbox” positions are recommended during low to moderate traffic levels when no other sector split is open. The provision of top-down services should be taken into consideration when selecting a position.
{.is-warning}

> The **East**, **South**, and **West** sector shall not be opened independently. It may only be operated when **LFRR_CTR** is online.
{.is-danger}
